_moduleContext.name: Calculator
_moduleContext.author: MAM Team
_moduleContext.description: Perform basic arithmetic operations with input validation and error handling
_moduleContext.purpose: Perform basic arithmetic operations with input validation and error handling

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The result of the arithmetic operation

rules: Division by zero must return an error message, not raise an exception
Invalid operation types must return an error message
All numeric inputs must be validated before processing
The operation_performed field must describe the operation in human-readable form
Results must be rounded to 10 decimal places to avoid floating-point artifacts
